title: Small and Medium Enterprises Amidst the Pandemic and Reopening: Digital Edge and Transformation
authors: Lin William Cong; Xiaohan Yang; Xiaobo Zhang
department: finance (per abstract: accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance; manuscript ID MS-FTFIN-2023-02424)
eligible_reason: Single common shock (COVID-19 lockdown, January 2020), no unit-specific adoption dates. SAIC registration data (Figures 2-5, Tables 5-7): city-industry-month panel in event time around Chinese New Year; regressors are yr2020 x event-month indicators (yr2020_mth_b6p ... yr2020_mth_a13p) comparing 2020 with earlier years, with city x industry x year and city x industry x event-month FE; e-commerce and non-e-commerce firms are separate regressions, and Tables 5-7 interact the post-2020 indicator with continuous city-level exposures (case rate, cluster index, financial inefficiency, digital finance index). ESIEC survey (Tables 3-4): cross-sectional regressions of pandemic outcomes on the time-invariant e-commerce indicator with controls and wave dummies. OSOME survey (Tables 8-9): covid_after indicator (single date) with firm-type, industry and revenue dummies and demographic controls, no unit FE.
design_notes: Main_SAIC data.do lines 58-65 (event-study on yr2020 x gap_mth), 136-137 (yr2020_after by industry), 210-231 (continuous exposure x yr2020_after). Main_ESIEC data.do: reghdfe outcome ecom $ctrl i.wave, absorb($fe) vce(r). Main_OSOME data.do: reghdfe outcome covid_after i.type_n i.ind_n i.rev_interval emp20 user_age female firm_age.
estimators_reported: TWFE-style event study around a single date (2020 vs earlier years)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One shock date (Jan 2020) for all units.
data_files: data/COVID_cases_China.dta (public case counts for Figure 1 only)
data_files_note: README: working_ESIEC.dta, working_OSOME.dta and working_SAIC.dta are not uploaded (NDA and confidential survey data); access via remote desktop at the Center for Enterprise Research, Peking University, upon request.
priority_note: Not eligible (single COVID shock); data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
